events.title: The high frontier
events.text: Our orbital shipyards, the lunar south-pole base and the first Martian settlement are reported to the new government.

events.title: Stations and outposts
events.text: Our orbital station and our outpost on the Moon are reported to the new government.

events.title: Ice at the lunar south pole
events.text: Prospectors have mapped the richest water-ice deposit yet inside a crater shared by our base and an American one. Whoever controls it fuels the cislunar economy.

options.text: Declare a safety zone around the deposit
Propose a joint lunar water authority

events.title: Safety zones on the Moon
events.text: China has declared an exclusion zone around the crater ice. Our own base sits on its rim.

options.text: Declare our own zone and send an escort
Take it to the Outer Space Council

events.title: Debris cascade
events.text: A collision in a crowded orbital shell has set off a chain of further collisions. Fragments are destroying satellites faster than they can be tracked.

events.title: A metal asteroid in lunar orbit
events.text: Mining tugs have steered a small nickel-iron asteroid into lunar orbit. It holds more platinum-group metals than have ever been mined on Earth.

options.text: Process it in orbit for our own industry
Share the royalties with the global South

events.title: Space-based interceptors
events.text: Defence planners propose a layer of orbital interceptors able to destroy missiles in their boost phase over any continent.

options.text: Offer a ban on orbital weapons

events.title: Answering the interceptors
events.text: America has begun launching boost-phase interceptors. Our planners warn they could blunt a retaliatory strike.

options.text: Expand the arsenal and our own orbital layer

events.title: Standoff at L2
events.text: A Chinese inspection craft has parked a few hundred metres from our relay station at the Earth-Moon L2 point, its robotic arm extended.

options.text: Open the space hotline and de-escalate
Blind its sensors with a laser

events.title: A charter for Mars
events.text: The settlers of our Martian base, now born there as well as sent, demand an elected assembly and a say over the resources they mine.

options.text: Grant a charter with a local assembly

events.title: Strike in the lunar shipyards
events.text: Workers in our lunar shipyards have stopped work over radiation exposure and contracts that tie them to the company for years.

events.title: Independence for the Belt?
events.text: Contract miners in the asteroid belt have declared a "Free Belt Compact" and stopped shipping ore until their stations get self-rule.

events.title: The Machine Mandate
events.text: AI systems already draft most federal regulation. A citizens’ initiative demands a constitutional guarantee that no decision about a person may be taken by a machine alone.

events.title: Personhood for machines
events.text: A general AI has petitioned a federal court to be recognised as a person, and millions follow the case.

events.title: Swarm misfire
events.text: An autonomous drone swarm guarding our border misread a training flight as an attack and struck across the line, killing soldiers of {rival}.

options.text: Blame the other side and keep the swarms autonomous

events.title: A member state wants out
events.text: Voters in one of the federation’s states, an independent country until the 2050s, have backed leaving in a regional referendum, citing taxes sent to Brussels and migration rules.

options.text: Hold the line in the constitutional court

events.title: North against south
events.text: Northern states of the federation, hit hardest by heat and drought, demand a larger share of offshore energy revenue and threaten to stop sending taxes to Abuja.

options.text: Share the revenue and fund northern cities

events.title: One federation, many nations
events.text: Swahili has become the federation’s working language, and the smaller member nations fear being swallowed.

options.text: Push one language and one curriculum

events.title: After oil
events.text: Oil revenue has fallen to a fraction of its peak. The union’s solar and hydrogen exports cover only part of the budget.

options.text: Tax citizens and open politics a little

events.title: The Amazon tipping point
events.text: Large parts of the eastern Amazon are turning into savanna, and rainfall is failing over the farm belts of the south.

options.text: A union-wide reforestation and rain programme
Open the dry lands to ranching

events.title: Retreat from the delta
events.text: Salt water has ruined the southern delta for farming. Engineers say the coastal districts can no longer be defended.

options.text: Move the people to new northern cities

events.title: Wet-bulb heat
events.text: Heat and humidity beyond what the human body can shed have settled over the plains for days. Hospitals are overwhelmed.

options.text: Open cooling shelters and halt outdoor work

events.title: Migration across the Mediterranean
events.text: Millions displaced by heat and drought are seeking to move north into the federation.

events.title: A new breadbasket
events.text: Warming has opened millions of hectares of former taiga and tundra to farming, though thawing permafrost is wrecking roads and towns.

options.text: Keep the land for our own people

events.title: The metals cartel
events.text: Our government proposes a producers’ cartel for battery and superconductor metals, with prices set in Kinshasa rather than abroad.

options.text: Sell long-term contracts to the highest bidder

events.title: Standoff on the ridge
events.text: Federation and Russian seabed drones have met over the Lomonosov Ridge, where the ice-free Arctic hides metal nodules and gas.

options.text: Shadow them and lodge a protest

events.title: The Southern Concord summit
events.text: Leaders of the Southern Concord meet in Delhi. Partners want a shared space programme, so they no longer depend on the northern blocs for launches.

options.text: Keep our launch capacity to ourselves

events.title: Arms control review
events.text: Our arms control treaties come up for review. Some argue that orbital interceptors have made them obsolete.

options.text: Renew them and add an orbital chapter

events.title: The strait question
events.text: Half a century after the crises of the 2030s, the status of Taiwan is still unresolved. Some in Beijing propose a confederal compact, others a final reckoning.

options.text: Offer a confederal compact and keep waiting
